title: Runtime Context Lens API — personal sketch
content:
Goal
-----
Personal sketch for a small, orthogonal API surface that lets clients (developer tools, admin UIs, and session-aware agents) open a lightweight read/write "lens" into a running session's context and cache state. Aim: let higher-level tooling explore and edit active context slices without forcing full session serialization or heavy-weight snapshot operations.

Why this exists
----------------
- Observability: surface what prefix/context is actually hitting the KV cache and how it changes over time.
- Repairability: enable quick, low-friction edits to session context (fix hallucinated facts, redact PII) with minimal risk.
- Cost-aware prefetch: give runtime hints about what to prewarm (KV, attention cache, embeddings) for imminent requests.
- Minimal privacy blast radius: lens operations are scoped and ephemeral, should not leak whole session state to UIs.

High-level principles
---------------------
1) Lens is ephemeral and scoped. A lens expires (TTL) and can be revoked.
2) All edits are recorded as deltas with a stable trace id for audit.
3) No implicit promotion: edits via a lens are opt-in to the actual session state (apply vs propose).
4) Lightweight: read paths should not force large materialization; support streaming incremental reads.
5) Access control: lens ops require session-level permission and scoped KMS assertions.

API surface (sketch)
--------------------
Note: these are draft endpoints — assume bearer token & session-scoped auth.

1) Create lens
POST /sessions/{session_id}/lenses
Body (json) example (as string here):
{
  "name": "editor-1",
  "selector": {
    "type": "prefix", "pattern": "user_context:/recent_commands/"
  },
  "read_mode": "stream|snapshot", 
  "ttl_seconds": 90,
  "prefetch_hints": ["kv:keys:top-10", "attn:kvcache:prefetch-3"],
  "stability_budget": 0.02
}
Response: 201 { "lens_id": "ln-8ah3", "expires_at": "2026-03-10T15:22:33Z" }

2) Read from lens (supports cursor streaming)
GET /sessions/{session_id}/lenses/{lens_id}/read?cursor={cursor}&limit=50
- Returns ordered items that match the selector. Each item includes: key, type, size_bytes, inferred_token_span, last_accessed, source_rank.
- Streaming: websocket or chunked-encoding for large slices.

3) Propose edit (non-destructive)
POST /sessions/{session_id}/lenses/{lens_id}/proposals
Body example:
{
  "op": "upsert",
  "key": "user_context:/recent_commands/4",
  "value": "Updated command: open_file --path=/etc/passwd sanitized",
  "author": "maya.chen",
  "note": "fix bad punctuation causing model confusion",
  "expected_version": 12
}
Response: 202 { "proposal_id": "prop-439", "preview_effect": { "cost_delta_token_est": 3, "latency_delta_ms": -12 } }

4) Apply proposal (requires explicit apply)
POST /sessions/{session_id}/lenses/{lens_id}/proposals/{proposal_id}/apply
- Returns audit entry id and snapshot delta pointer (for rollback).
- Support conditional apply (if session-version unchanged) and forced apply with warning.

5) Patch / batch ops for administrative workflows
PATCH /sessions/{session_id}/lenses/{lens_id}/batch
Body: list of operations (upsert/delete/ttl-update).

6) Observe prefetch plan (read-only)
GET /sessions/{session_id}/lenses/{lens_id}/prefetch-plan
- Runtime returns a ranked list of candidate warm-up actions with expected cost & SLO impact. Useful for UI showing "prewarm recommended".

Message shapes to capture in docs (flat text JSON earlier is OK)
- Lens metadata: lens_id, creator, created_at, selector, read_mode, ttl, access_scope, linked_ticket
- Proposal object: proposal_id, ops[], author, created_at, preview_summary, status
- Audits: audit_id, action, actor, result, snapshot_ptr

Edge interactions with runtime internals
--------------------------------------
- KV cache map: lens should consult the cache index (small, key->meta) not full blobs when doing list operations.
- Prefix caching: if selector is prefix, runtime can materialize a compact dir listing that contains token-span summaries (approx token count, last-seen).
- Attn/KV cache touches: prefetch_hints translate to (kernel-level) prewarm commands: prefetch kv-keys => ensures keys in device DRAM; prefetch attn => warm per-layer KV layers for keys that will likely be used in next N tokens.
- Embeddings/lookup: hints can trigger embedding-cache warmups for keys used by reranker or retrieval.

Sequence diagram (ascii)
-----------------------
Client -> API: POST /sessions/123/lenses {selector}
API -> RuntimeIndex: resolve selector -> small index
RuntimeIndex -> API: index-slice (meta)
API -> Client: lens_id + preview (stream)
Client -> API: POST proposals
API -> Auditing: record proposal
API -> Runtime: dry-run cost model => preview_effect
API -> Client: 202 + preview_effect
Client -> API: POST apply
API -> Runtime: apply delta -> update session cache
Runtime -> API: emit event (session.change, audit_id)

Concurrency & conflicts
-----------------------
- Use optimistic concurrency: proposals include expected_version. If base version diverged, server returns 409 with conflict summary.
- Merge rules for small key-value edits: last-writer wins unless proposal includes merge_strategy: "append" | "overwrite" | "merge-json".
- For structured blobs (e.g., user-profile json) recommend requiring 'merge-json' and a dry-run merge preview.

Telemetry / Observability hooks
-------------------------------
- Events: lens.created, lens.read.page, proposal.created, proposal.preview, proposal.applied, lens.revoked.
- Metrics: avg_proposals_per_lens, median_preview_latency, apply_failure_rate, prefetch_effectiveness_ratio.
- Traces: propagate session-trace-id; record time spent in index-resolve vs apply.

Security & privacy considerations
---------------------------------
- Default: lens read_mode = "metadata_only" unless client requests full_blob and has admin scope. UI should minimize accidental exposure.
- PII redact: runtime can auto-mask if configured by tenant policies; proposals that add PII should be rejected or flagged.
- Audit trail retention configurable per-tenant; proposals/changes must carry actor and reason.

Open questions (TODOs)
---------------------
- Should lenses be tenant-scoped only (strongly recommended) or cross-tenant for SRE? Define guardrails.
- What is the canonical selector language? Right now a tiny DSL (prefix, key_regex, tag=...). Might borrow from ingress-shard selector syntax.
- Should we expose a read-only sample_tokens field per key that indicates tokenization mapping? Useful but blows data transfer. Maybe on-demand.
- UX: how to show 'preview_effect' cost model in a way product teams understand? Units: tokens, ms, dollars estimate.
- Does apply trigger model-internal cache invalidation or does it rely on eventual consistency? Recommend immediate sync for small keys, background for heavy blobs.

Quick local dev checklist
------------------------
- runtime: index-resolve endpoint -> return small index proto (mockable)
- api: lens manager + audit table (sqlite/pg)
- cost-model: lightweight function that estimates token delta and latency delta
- webui: simple lens explorer showing keys, sample value (masked), propose/apply flows

Notes to self
-------------
- Keep lenses small and visible in tooling; avoid them becoming a backdoor to export full session dumps.
- Consider adding a feature gate: "enable_lens_admin" at tenant level.
- Later: tie to rollout system so a canary fix can be pushed via lens-based proposals applied across a sampled set of sessions.

References & related PRs
------------------------
- See in linked_artifacts for current draft PR & confluence page.
- Runbook idea: small revision rollback -> store snapshot_ptr on apply to allow 5-min rollbacks via /revert endpoint.

End of sketch — rough and exploratory. Will iterate after pragmatic feedback from SRE + Console team.
